name: axoniq-migration
description: Upgrade applications from Axon Framework 4 to Axon Framework 5 / Axoniq Framework 5, then upgrade legacy sagas to workflows with verified coexistence and drain.

interface.shortDescription: Axon Framework 4 to Axoniq Framework 5 upgrade skills.
interface.longDescription: Skills for Axon Framework 4 to 5 upgrades and legacy saga to workflow upgrade. Bundles the upgrade orchestrator, OpenRewrite runner, isolated-test helper, and a behavior-preserving workflow upgrade skill with coexistence and drain guidance.
defaultPrompt: Plan an Axon 4 to 5 upgrade for this repository.
Run the Axon 4 to 5 OpenRewrite upgrade.
Set up isolated tests for an Axon upgrade target.
Upgrade this legacy Axon saga to an Axoniq workflow, preserving behavior while existing sagas drain.
